title: DASDG: Traffic-flow forecasting under persistent sensor missingness

creators.name: Li, Zhuorui
creators.affiliation: School of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hunan University of Technology and Business

description: DASDG 1.1.0 unifies configurable training, causal prediction, epoch-boundary full-state resume, evidence validation and preserved traffic-study workflows. The training and prediction runtime is byte-identical to the 1.1.0rc1 candidate that passed 20 CPU core checks and 17 unified/GPU checks on an RTX 4090 D. These are synthetic software checks, not real nontraffic performance evidence. Frozen traffic configurations and data contracts are provided; original traffic data, masks, weights and external DGCRN author source are not bundled. The upstream DGCRN LICENSE and README licence labels are inconsistent and remain unclarified; the MIT core provides only its own adapter and pinned-source verification. Previous v1.0.2 materials remain separately identified under archival/.
notes: Preserve the existing DASDG version series. Do not use the v1.0.2 DOI as the identifier for 1.1.0. External upstream source is excluded from the MIT core.
